Section: PIPELINE — HOW AN ENEMY TRAINER TEAM IS FORMED

Detail: assignTrainers() runs ONCE at run start: picks a trainer NAME per Battle event row and stores it in sm.trainerAssignments (persisted in save). 4 passes: gym leaders -> gym trainers (type-matched) -> Elite-Four canon pins -> rivals + remaining.
On entering a battle event, the trainer is resolved. Basic/Gym-Trainer events are GENERATED on the fly (dynamic type + generic sprite + no sigs). Named events look up the stored name.
Build tier for the event is chosen by _storyBuildTierForEvent (UNTRAINED/NOVICE/COMPETENT/TOURNAMENT) from event type + badges.
rollTrainerTeam() builds the 6-mon team: roll signatures (if any) under the gen filter + grade ceiling + evo-stage cap, then fill remaining slots from a type/grade pool.
Per-mon build: species -> makeBuild -> tier downgrade -> city-curve EVs/IVs -> nature/ability/move optimization gradient -> item tier -> mechanic (Mega/Tera/Z/Dynamax) roll.
Non-rival rolls are SEEDED by (runSeed, eventIdx) so they are STATIC across refresh/flee/revisit. The Rival is UNSEEDED — it re-rolls a fresh counter to the player's LIVE party.
Result is frozen into sm.currentEnemyLock for the current fight (mid-fight reload resumes the same team).
Power tier of a species by BST. G1 = strongest, G4 = weakest. Grade rolls skew toward G1/G2 as city + trainer quality rise.
UNTRAINED -> NOVICE -> COMPETENT -> TOURNAMENT. Controls how optimized EV/IV/nature/ability/moves are.
Story progression node. C0 = pre-first-gym ... C8 = legendary/mystery ... C9 = League.
Basic / Stage1+Basic / ALL — limits how evolved an enemy/gift/wild species can be by city.
A trainer's identity Pokemon (TRAINER_DATA.sigs). Scales by grade-devolution + gen-fallback. Multiset allowed.
Static = same result every time (seeded). Dynamic = re-rolls (only the Rival).
